findings.title: Guard bits lost
findings.body: `h` and `a` are converted with `_to_mpmath(prec)` before `workprec(prec + 10)` takes effect. For inputs that are not exactly representable (e.g. `Rational(1, 3)`, `sqrt(2)`), the arguments are already rounded at the target precision. The extra 10 bits then only help the quadrature, not the input error, so last-digit accuracy can still suffer. Converting with `_to_mpmath(prec + 10)` would match the stated intent in the comment.

Guard bits lost
`h` and `a` are converted with `_to_mpmath(prec)` before `workprec(prec + 10)` takes effect. For inputs that are not exactly representable (e.g. `Rational(1, 3)`, `sqrt(2)`), the arguments are already rounded at the target precision. The extra 10 bits then only help the quadrature, not the input error, so last-digit accuracy can still suffer. Converting with `_to_mpmath(prec + 10)` would match the stated intent in the comment.
